page_notes.field_art: The disc carries no create-team or field-art container: its field is one member, field.tab, which is a CRLF ASCII table and is edited on the Gameplay page rather than duplicated here. Every other art member on the disc is a RenderWare texture dictionary and is reached from Uniforms & Equipment, Menus & UI or All Textures.
page_notes.stadiums: Stadium geometry is in the 1,272 .dff members, and they are RenderWare clump streams: a top-level walk consumes 1,043 of them exactly and the sequence is Clump then Extension. Reading a clump's geometry, materials and frames is a different reader from the texture-dictionary one this module ships, so the .dff members are counted and named on the Presentation page's inventory and no stadium editor is offered.
page_notes.crib: The Crib is an ESPN NFL 2K5 feature and not an NFL Blitz concept, so this page stays empty here on purpose.
page_notes.audio: All of this disc's audio is one member, mslasset.ms2, 137,538,180 bytes, a Midway sound bank. That format is owned by another module in this repository and is not opened here; this module names the member, its size and its CRC-32 in the All Textures inventory's sibling counts and reads none of it.
page_notes.saves: A save is not the disc. The two .ico members are PlayStation 2 save icons for the dashboard, not saves, and no NFL Blitz 2002 memory-card save has been measured by this project.
